hunks.baseline: “Because you’re my friend, too.”
hunks.sol: *Because you’re my friend, too.*

hunks.baseline: At those quiet words, the Skeleton King’s eyes trembled faintly. I looked straight at him and continued.
hunks.sol: At those quiet words, the Skeleton King’s eyes trembled. I looked straight at him and continued.

hunks.baseline: “That’s all there is to it. You’re my friend, too. If I lost you like this, I’d feel like shit for the rest of my life. That’s why I can’t give up.”
hunks.sol: *That’s all there is to it. You’re my friend, too. If I lost you like this, I’d feel like shit for the rest of my life. That’s why I can’t give up.*

hunks.baseline: “Remember when we fought the Arch Lich in China?”
hunks.sol: *Remember when we fought the Arch Lich in China?*

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King silently nodded at my question.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King nodded silently.

hunks.baseline: Yeah. How could I forget?
hunks.sol: Yeah. How could either of us forget?

hunks.baseline: The memory of that fierce day was still etched vividly in my mind.
hunks.sol: That fierce battle was still etched vividly in my mind.

hunks.baseline: “I really thought I was going to die. No—if things had kept going the way they were, I’d probably have died nine times out of ten.”
hunks.sol: *I really thought I was going to die. No—if things had kept going the way they were, I’d have died nine times out of ten.*

hunks.baseline: It had been that hard of a fight.
hunks.sol: It had been that hard a fight.

hunks.baseline: The countless monsters blocking our path—and the Arch Lich we’d finally faced after putting down Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing, who had chosen to betray us—had been too much for me at the time.
hunks.sol: Countless monsters had blocked our path. And the Arch Lich we’d finally faced after killing Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing, who had chosen to betray us, had been too much for me at the time.

hunks.baseline: “You saved me. Even knowing you might be erased.”
hunks.sol: *You saved me. Even though it meant risking Erasure.*

hunks.baseline: I could still picture it clearly. In that life-or-death moment, he had leaped out of my Inventory without even asking permission and taken the Arch Lich’s strike in my place.
hunks.sol: I could still see him leaping out of my Inventory without even asking permission and taking the Arch Lich’s strike in my place at that life-or-death moment.

hunks.baseline: A purely selfless and noble sacrifice.
hunks.sol: A pure, noble sacrifice.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, it was a great deed that allowed an ordinary someone to finally become a new being.
hunks.sol: The kind of act through which someone ordinary could become someone new.

hunks.baseline: And so the Skeleton Warlord, who had ruled the Black Forest, received a crown.
hunks.sol: And so the Skeleton Warlord who had ruled the Black Forest gained a crown.

hunks.baseline: He returned from the brink of Erasure, took up the radiant [Hero’s Sword], and drove it into the Arch Lich’s chest.
hunks.sol: He returned from the brink of Erasure, took the radiant Hero’s Sword in hand, and drove it into the Arch Lich’s chest.

hunks.baseline: “Why did you make that choice back then?”
hunks.sol: *Why did you make that choice?*

hunks.baseline: “……Who knows. I don’t.”
hunks.sol: *……I don’t know.*

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King gazed up at empty space and muttered.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King turned his gaze to empty space and muttered.

hunks.baseline: “All I know is that I had a very stupid, very trivial reason.”
hunks.sol: *All I know is that I had a very stupid, very small reason.*

hunks.baseline: “A reason?”
hunks.sol: *A reason?*

hunks.baseline: “There was something I’d always wondered. Who am I? Where was I born, and what sin did I commit to become the monster I am now? Surely I wasn’t always like this.”
hunks.sol: *There was something I’d always wondered. Who am I? Where was I born, and what did I do wrong to become the monster I am now? Surely I wasn’t always like this.*

hunks.baseline: “But no matter how hard I tried, I couldn’t remember anything from when I was alive. Even in the human world, every moment I spent with humans left me confused. I felt like something that was neither a monster nor a human. As if I were being punished without end for a sin I’d committed in the past.”
hunks.sol: *But no matter how hard I tried, I couldn’t remember my life before this. Even while living among humans, I was confused every moment I spent with them. I felt like something that was neither monster nor human. As though I were serving an endless sentence for a sin I’d committed in the past.*

hunks.baseline: He was always lost in thought with a troubled look on his face. Sometimes, he’d go into my Inventory and not say a word for days.
hunks.sol: He was always lost in thought, looking troubled. Sometimes he’d go into my Inventory and not say a word for days.

hunks.baseline: Then one day, I’d casually said to him:
hunks.sol: Then one day, I’d said something to him in passing.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know for sure, but I was sure he had been.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know for sure, but I was certain of it.

hunks.baseline: “That was why. I wanted to believe those words, which might have been nothing more than comfort. And, in a way, I wanted to prove them. If I really had been a decent guy in the past…”
hunks.sol: *That was why. Maybe you’d only said it to comfort me, but I wanted to believe you. And part of me wanted to prove you right. If I really had been a decent guy in the past…*

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King slowly tilted his head. His gaze dropped from the empty space and slid toward me.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King slowly tilted his head. His gaze left the empty space and settled on me.

hunks.baseline: “Then I might be able to sacrifice myself for someone else… for a friend.”
hunks.sol: *Then perhaps I could sacrifice myself for someone else… for a friend.*

hunks.baseline: “Yes, that’s right, you damn crafty human.”
hunks.sol: *Yes, that’s right, you damn crafty human.*

hunks.baseline: “You were the first friend this body made after coming into this world.”
hunks.sol: *You were the first friend this body made after coming into this world.*

hunks.baseline: I had to say something. I should have. But not a single word or phrase came to mind.
hunks.sol: I had to say something. I should have, but not a single word came to mind.

hunks.baseline: I lifted the corners of my mouth and laughed silently, then let out a few short chuckles before I couldn’t hold back any longer and burst out laughing.
hunks.sol: I smiled silently at first, then let out a few quiet chuckles before I couldn’t hold back any longer and burst out laughing.

hunks.baseline: Loud enough for everyone to hear across the enormous round table. Loud enough for hundreds of pairs of eyes to turn toward us.
hunks.sol: Loud enough for everyone across the enormous round table to hear. Loud enough to draw hundreds of pairs of eyes toward us.

hunks.baseline: Then I looked at the Skeleton King, who was blinking in surprise.
hunks.sol: Then I looked at the Skeleton King, who was blinking in surprise, and said, “You only figured out something that simple now, you dumbass?”

hunks.baseline: “You only figured out something that simple now, you dumbass?”
“Just say it out loud. Don’t whisper behind everyone’s backs.”
hunks.sol: “Just say it out loud. Stop whispering so no one else can hear.”

hunks.baseline: “No, what is this—”
hunks.sol: “What the—”

hunks.baseline: “You lunatic.”
hunks.sol: “Madman.”

hunks.baseline: “What, a lunatic? Are you finished?”
hunks.sol: “What, madman? You finished?”

hunks.baseline: “I wasn’t finished. Attention-seeking bastard.”
hunks.sol: “I’m not finished. You attention-seeking bastard.”

hunks.baseline: “Man—what?”
hunks.sol: “Manage… what?”

hunks.baseline: Suddenly singled out, Team Leader Choi clenched his teeth, looking as if grim reality had just hit him.
hunks.sol: Suddenly singled out, Team Leader Choi clenched his teeth. He looked like he’d just remembered how he’d ended up here.

hunks.baseline: “I’m the one who should be hurt. If things had gone according to plan, in a little while… No, why even call it a plan if you’re going to do this?”
hunks.sol: “I’m the one whose feelings are hurt. If things had gone according to plan, in a little while… No, why even make a plan if you’re going to do this?”

hunks.baseline: People’s affairs often took turns no one could predict. Just like right now.
hunks.sol: People’s plans often went in directions no one could predict. Just like right now.

hunks.baseline: Even so, not a trace of unease crossed my mind about the plan going out of order.
hunks.sol: Even so, I wasn’t the least bit uneasy about having done things out of order.

hunks.baseline: Yeah. If that was how it turned out, then so be it.
hunks.sol: Yeah. That was good enough for me.

hunks.baseline: I burst out laughing again, then lowered my voice as if I meant business and addressed Team Leader Choi.
hunks.sol: I burst out laughing again, then put on a deep, serious voice as I addressed Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: “Come on, try saying it with me. Heave. Ho. Heave. Ho.”
hunks.sol: “Come on, say it with me. Heave. Ho. Heave. Ho.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re putting up a front for no reason. You’re seriously sulking, aren’t you? This was going to happen anyway.”
hunks.sol: “You’re acting all stubborn because you’re sulking, aren’t you? This was going to happen anyway.”

hunks.baseline: “No. Today, I’m going to crush it up and eat it without boiling it.”
hunks.sol: “No. Today I’m crushing it up and eating it without boiling it.”

hunks.baseline: “You little shit—!”
hunks.sol: “You motherfucking—!”

hunks.baseline: And just as Team Leader Choi’s eyes rolled back and he lost control, about to spring to his feet, two enormous hands reached out from behind him and grabbed him.
hunks.sol: Just as Team Leader Choi’s eyes rolled back and he was about to spring to his feet, two enormous hands shot out from behind him and grabbed him.

hunks.baseline: “Please, get a grip! I know Jin made a mistake, too, but… Wait. Have you been bulking up lately?”
hunks.sol: “Please, get a grip! I think Jin made a mistake, too, but… Wait. Have you been bulking up lately?”

hunks.baseline: This was a mess beyond all messes.
hunks.sol: What a fucking mess.

hunks.baseline: Wide-open mouths. Faces asking what the hell was going on. Eyes gone unfocused.
hunks.sol: Open mouths. Faces asking what the hell was going on. Eyes gone unfocused.

hunks.baseline: A commotion had erupted out of nowhere at this important meeting to elect the World Hunter Federation’s representative as humanity faced a crisis. Everyone looked as if they’d just seen Demon King Asmodeus brought back with Edo Tensei[^1].
hunks.sol: At this crucial gathering to elect the World Hunter Federation’s leader while humanity faced a crisis, everyone looked as if they’d just seen Demon King Asmodeus resurrected with Edo Tensei[^1].

hunks.baseline: [^1]: A technique from *Naruto* that summons the dead back to life.
hunks.sol: [^1]: Edo Tensei is a technique in *Naruto* that summons the dead back to life.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, I’m sorry. I wasn’t planning to spring it on you right now.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, I’m sorry. I wasn’t planning to spring this on you yet.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel pretended to answer with the bleak resignation of a terminal lung cancer patient, all while puffing on his cigar twice as fast.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel answered with the gloom of a terminal lung cancer patient—or pretended to—while puffing on his cigar twice as fast.

hunks.baseline: But if I had to name the one person among the three hundred gathered here who was the most confused, it would be Michael Silbert.
hunks.sol: But if I had to name the most bewildered person among the three hundred gathered here, it would be Michael Silbert.

hunks.baseline: His voice slipped through space and into my ear.
hunks.sol: His voice crossed the space between us and reached my ear.

hunks.baseline: Seeing his face, stiffer than I’d ever seen it, I couldn’t help but let out a laugh.
hunks.sol: His face was stiffer than I’d ever seen it. I couldn’t help laughing.

hunks.baseline: It was only natural to answer someone who was curious.
hunks.sol: It was only polite to answer a question.

hunks.baseline: The voice in my ear cut off. By now, everyone in the room was looking back and forth between me and Michael Silbert, following my gaze.
hunks.sol: The voice in my ear cut off. By now, everyone in the room was following my gaze, looking back and forth between Michael Silbert and me.

hunks.baseline: “If you have something to say, say it out loud so everyone can hear. Don’t whisper in people’s ears at your age.”
hunks.sol: “If you have something to say, say it out loud so everyone can hear. You’re too old to be whispering in my ear.”

hunks.baseline: After saying that, it struck me as a little too rude, so I shyly added one more thing.
hunks.sol: That sounded a little rude, so I shyly added one more thing.

hunks.baseline: “You son of a bitch.”
hunks.sol: “You motherfucker.”

hunks.baseline: The whole room fell silent, as if hundreds of nuclear missiles had swept through it. The air surrounding us froze.
hunks.sol: The room went silent, as if hundreds of nuclear missiles had swept through it. The air around us froze.

hunks.baseline: But unlike the others watching this unbelievable scene, to me that cold air felt like it had finally cleared the blockage in my throat and chest.
hunks.sol: But unlike the others watching this unbelievable scene, I welcomed that cold air. It felt as if something blocking my throat and chest had finally cleared.

hunks.baseline: After taking a deep breath, I started walking at a leisurely pace. I passed between the round tables, then got tired of even that after a few steps and leaped over everyone’s heads.
hunks.sol: I took a deep breath and started walking. I passed between sections of the round table, then, after a few steps, got tired of even that and leaped over everyone’s heads.

hunks.baseline: I saw Michael Silbert clench his teeth, unable to bring himself to step into that space, as though an invisible wall held him back.
hunks.sol: Michael Silbert clenched his teeth. He stood there unable to set foot in that space, as though an invisible wall held him back.

hunks.baseline: In the eyes of the man glaring at me, there was anger he couldn’t hide. And I knew exactly why he was angry.
hunks.sol: His eyes, fixed on me, held anger he couldn’t hide. And I knew exactly why.

hunks.baseline: “Honestly, I understand to some extent. I’ve been through something similar before. One day, I was looking for the ice cream I’d saved to eat after a bath, but when I came back out, my little sister had eaten all of it and left me the wrapper. I was pretty pissed. But…”
hunks.sol: “Honestly, I understand. Something similar happened to me once. I’d saved some ice cream to eat after my bath, but when I came out, my little sister had eaten it all and left me the wrapper. I was pretty pissed. But…”

hunks.baseline: I trailed off, gazing at Michael Silbert’s rigid face, and continued slowly.
hunks.sol: I trailed off, watching Michael Silbert’s rigid face, then continued slowly.

hunks.baseline: “Then I suddenly thought, what am I getting so mad about over something this trivial? Is it really worth throwing a fit over?”
hunks.sol: “Then I thought, why am I getting so mad over something this small? Is it really worth throwing a fit over?”

hunks.baseline: Naturally. I’d caused a scene at the most important moment, hurled curses at a Senior, and now I was telling an ice cream story nobody had asked for.
hunks.sol: Of course they were. I’d caused a scene at the worst possible moment, cursed out a Senior, and now I was telling an ice cream story nobody had asked for.

hunks.baseline: But their expressions were so funny that I ended up laughing.
hunks.sol: Their expressions were so funny that I laughed again.

hunks.baseline: “Anyway, that’s all.”
hunks.sol: “Anyway. That’s what happened.”

hunks.baseline: *Crack! Rumble!*
hunks.sol: *Crack! Crunch!*

hunks.baseline: Michael Silbert’s belated shout was swallowed by the roar.
hunks.sol: Michael Silbert’s belated shout vanished beneath the roar.

hunks.baseline: In the split second when nobody could stop me, I completely crushed the center of the round table, a place set aside for just one man. Then I looked at the faces staring at me in shock.
hunks.sol: In the instant before anyone could stop me, I crushed the center of the round table, the place reserved for just one person. Then I looked at the shocked faces around me.

hunks.baseline: “After thinking about it, I realized that seat was just like that ice cream. If nobody was greedy, there’d be nothing to get angry about. But the greedy ones always step forward and cause trouble.”
hunks.sol: “The more I thought about it, the more that seat seemed like the ice cream. If nobody wanted it so badly, nobody would have a reason to get angry. But the greedy ones always step forward and cause trouble.”

hunks.baseline: Of course, there was an incomparably vast difference between ice cream and the World Hunter Federation.
hunks.sol: Of course, the difference between ice cream and the World Hunter Federation was beyond comparison.

hunks.baseline: The importance of each in this world. And…the scale of the fallout caused by that greed.
hunks.sol: Their importance in this world. And… the scale of what that greed had caused.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of thousands of people had lost their families and friends, their homes and their hopes.
hunks.sol: More than a hundred thousand people had lost family and friends, homes and hope.

hunks.baseline: So what was the difference between that seat and ice cream?
hunks.sol: So what made that seat any different from the ice cream?

hunks.baseline: It was ridiculous. It was hollow.
hunks.sol: It was ridiculous. And it left me feeling hollow.

hunks.baseline: Then I spoke to the hundreds of people looking at me in shock.
hunks.sol: I spoke to the hundreds of people staring at me in shock.
